content.short: Nest is a liquidity, growth and yield layer on Hyperliquid helping assets bootstrap markets.
content.description: Nest is a MetaDEX on Hyperliquid that helps new assets launch, bootstrap liquidity and scale into HyperCore. It converts protocol revenue into HYPE and distributes it to participants through mechanisms it calls the HYPE Spring and HYPE Engine. Emissions run on an epoch system that governance votes direct.
content.meta: Helps new assets on Hyperliquid reach a market deep enough for the price to mean something.
